senses.gloss: m. (גלד) gildana, name of a certain fish with a thick fatty skin.
units: Snh. 100ᵇ לא תנטוש גיל׳ וכ׳ (Ms. M. תפשוט) do not begin to strip the gildana from its gill, lest its skin go to ruin (a citation from Ben Sira).
B. Bath. 73ᵇ ההוא ג׳ וכ׳ that was a sea gildana (a small fish among the sea monsters).
<cite ref="Tamid 32b:8">Tam. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ דמלחא</he> Rashi (ed. <cite ref="C00384"><he>גולדנא</he></cite>) salted g.
